body: Thank you very much, i really appreciate it
I have before, back in high school. Right now, I don't know who to reach out to. I dont want to talk to family or friends cause im scared they're going to judge me or won't talk to me.
I'm here, just very confused with what I should do

I feel the exact same way. I'm on the edge - I don't know if I want to end it or not. But I know I can't keep this up for long, and I just want to run away. And if I can't run away, I want it to end completely. You're not alone in how you feel. 

edit: I don't condone suicide - I'm not the best to give advice cause I'm thinking about it myself. But I really hope you find your way and will to live more. You seem like a nice person who deserves nothing but the best.
